transcript.text: roomba e5 wont charge properly, sometimes it does sometimes it doesnt

Intermittent charging is most often poor contact between the Roomba and its dock — dust, floor-cleaner residue or slight oxidation on the metal contacts can be enough. The next possibilities are an intermittent dock power connection or a battery/charging fault inside the robot. Switch off and unplug the Home Base first. Wipe the metal charging strips on the underside of the Roomba and the matching contacts on the dock with a dry, soft cloth; do not use sprays or abrasives. Reconnect the dock, make sure its plug and cable are firmly seated, then place the robot squarely on the base. Does the dock’s power light remain on, and does the charging indication on the Roomba become reliable after this?
ok did that. contacts were greasy grey and loads of hair on the robot ones. dock light comes on when it docks. been charging every night for 4 days now, no error

That points strongly to the dirty, hair-covered charging contacts being the cause. With four nights of reliable charging and no error after cleaning, there is no reason to check the dock or battery. Wipe the contacts dry every few weeks and keep hair clear from the robot’s contact area; avoid sprays or wet cleaners on them. If it becomes intermittent again despite clean contacts, the next suspects would be the dock power lead or the robot’s battery/charging circuit. Is there anything else you need help with?

candidates: Dirty or oxidised charging contacts on the robot or Home Base (high)
Home Base power supply, plug or cable connection issue (medium)
Tired battery or internal charging fault (medium)

Stage 1 (broad help): say what could cause this, most likely first, as possibilities rather than certainties, including simple causes (settings, loading, detergent, installation, or normal behaviour) where they fit. Then give the one or two safe checks, or the one question, that would best tell those causes apart. Do not ask for the model number in this reply. Do not tell them to buy, order or replace a part yet.
